apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.0.1 — fixes from on-device testing: Varisai highlighting is smooth (the grid no longer rebuilds the whole screen per note) and the pattern menu stays stable during playback; the Ragas piano now follows the exact v14 layout — keys sized to the container, Sa at the left edge, top Sa ending at the right edge.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Varisai highlight performance + piano layout fixes.
